verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that connects its platform to AI clients such as Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code, letting users ask questions, explore experiments, and access Statsig data. It also offers a separate keyless Docs MCP server for documentation, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documentation of the exposed tool set, write capabilities, and auth/setup details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
